title: Internal AI platform: LLM gateway and agent runtime
summary: A shared platform providing a governed LLM gateway (multi-provider), RAG building blocks, agent runtime (LangGraph), evaluation and observability for all AI use cases.

fields.title: Internal AI platform: LLM gateway and agent runtime
fields.summary: A shared platform providing a governed LLM gateway (multi-provider), RAG building blocks, agent runtime (LangGraph), evaluation and observability for all AI use cases.
fields.problem_statement: Each team integrates LLM providers independently, duplicating security reviews, cost controls, evaluation tooling and monitoring.
fields.solution_description: Central gateway with provider abstraction, PII filtering, quota and cost tracking, prompt registry, evaluation harness and tracing. Domain assistants are deployed on this runtime.
kpis: Time to deploy a new assistant 3 months -> 3 weeks

allowed_transitions.gate: Investment gate: risk tier validated, dependencies known, sponsor committed.
